mapper.sql: SELECT h.INSTITUTION_ID FROM INST_BID_TARGET h WHERE h.KIND_CD = 'GOAL' AND h.TARGET_YEAR = #{year}
mapper.select: SELECT b.INSTITUTION_ID, b.TARGET_NO, b.REV_NO, b.ACTION_CD, b.KIND_CD, b.TARGET_YEAR, b.TAG_CD, b.OWNER_NAME, b.CANCEL_REASON_CD, b.CANCEL_REASON_ETC, b.SAVED_AT, i.NAME_KO AS INSTITUTION_NAME, i.REGION_CODE, c.CODE_NAME AS TAG_NAME, d.CODE_NAME AS CANCEL_REASON_NAME FROM INST_BID_TARGET b LEFT JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.INSTITUTION_ID = b.INSTITUTION_ID LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE c ON c.CODE_GROUP = 'TARGET_TAG' AND c.CODE = b.TAG_CD LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE d ON d.CODE_GROUP = 'TARGET_CANCEL_REASON' AND d.CODE = b.CANCEL_REASON_CD WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INST_BID_TARGET n WHERE n.INSTITUTION_ID = b.INSTITUTION_ID AND n.TARGET_NO = b.TARGET_NO AND n.REV_NO > b.REV_NO) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INST_BID_TARGET h WHERE h.INSTITUTION_ID = b.INSTITUTION_ID AND h.TARGET_NO = b.TARGET_NO AND h.KIND_CD = 'GOAL' AND h.TARGET_YEAR = #{year}) ORDER BY i.NAME_KO, b.INSTITUTION_ID, b.TARGET_NO

SELECT k.INSTITUTION_ID, k.CONTRACT_NO, k.REV_NO, k.RANK_CD, k.BANK_CD, k.BANK_NAME_ETC, k.TERM_FROM, k.TERM_TO, k.SRC_KIND, k.CHECKED_DATE, c.CODE_NAME AS BANK_NAME FROM INST_BANK_CONTRACT k LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE c ON c.CODE_GROUP = 'BANK' AND c.CODE = k.BANK_CD WHERE k.ACTION_CD = 'SAVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INST_BANK_CONTRACT n WHERE n.INSTITUTION_ID = k.INSTITUTION_ID AND n.CONTRACT_NO = k.CONTRACT_NO AND n.REV_NO > k.REV_NO) AND k.INSTITUTION_ID IN () ORDER BY k.INSTITUTION_ID, k.CONTRACT_NO

SELECT p.BID_CASE_ID, p.INSTITUTION_ID, p.STATE_CD, p.CONFIRMED_AT, p.UPDATED_AT, c.CODE_NAME AS STATE_NAME FROM BID_PREP p LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE c ON c.CODE_GROUP = 'PREP_STATE' AND c.CODE = p.STATE_CD WHERE p.CONFIRMED_AT >= #{fromAt} AND p.CONFIRMED_AT < #{toAt} AND p.INSTITUTION_ID IN () ORDER BY p.INSTITUTION_ID, p.UPDATED_AT DESC

SELECT s.INSTITUTION_ID, s.TARGET_YEAR, s.REV_NO, s.ACTION_CD, s.TERM_START FROM INST_BID_TERM s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INST_BID_TERM n WHERE n.INSTITUTION_ID = s.INSTITUTION_ID AND n.TARGET_YEAR = s.TARGET_YEAR AND n.REV_NO > s.REV_NO) AND s.INSTITUTION_ID IN () ORDER BY s.INSTITUTION_ID, s.TARGET_YEAR
SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = #{group} AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SORT_NO, CODE
